findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "synap_list_models" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: synap_chat_completion, synap_estimate_cost · Private data: synap_chat_completion, synap_list_models, synap_get_model, synap_estimate_cost · Public sink: synap_chat_completion.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: synap_chat_completion, synap_estimate_cost · Private data: synap_chat_completion, synap_list_models, synap_get_model, synap_estimate_cost · Public sink: synap_chat_completion

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "synap_chat_completion" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
